# Straiker — Deep-Dive Profile

## What they sell
Three-pillar product suite:
1. **Discover AI:** AI agent inventory + **AI-SPM / Agent-SPM** (security posture management).
2. **Ascend AI:** Continuous red-teaming of agents "across tools, MCP servers, and workflows to expose real attack paths before production".
3. **Defend AI:** Runtime security/guardrails — detects and blocks prompt injection, data exfiltration, and agent manipulation in real time.

## Core technological claims
1. **Discover AI specifics:**
   - **Complete agent inventory:** auto-catalog every agent incl. builder platforms (**Bedron Agentcore, Azure Foundry, MS Copilot Studio**) and coding agents (**Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot**).
   - **MCP server & Claude Skills discovery:** uncovers connected MCP servers/Skills and maps how they extend agent capabilities via tools/APIs/data access.
   - **Agent-SPM:** continuous evaluation of every agent's security configuration, permissions, blast radius; detects over-permissioned agents, risky MCP connections, and misconfigurations.
   - **Observability:** how agents interact with tools/data/systems; unknown agents, risky integrations, emerging attack paths.
   - **Framework mapping:** findings map to **OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF**; dedicated's solution page for **EU AI Act**.
2. **Defend AI specifics:**
   - **Runtime security:** inspects every prompt, reasoning step, and tool call to stop prompt injection, data exfiltration, and agent manipulation.
   - **MCP & Tool Security:** detects malicious or vulnerable MCP servers and tool connections in real time, backed by **Straiker's MCP Threat Database**.
   - **Coverage:** coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot), productivity agents (MS Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise), and custom-built agents (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry).

## Credibility signals
- **Partnerships:** OpenAI Select Partner, NVIDIA Inception Program, OWASP GenAI Security Project member.
- **Certifications:** IT-Harvest "Guardian of the Machine Age" badge, Sensiba ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, Cloud Security Alliance member, OWASP AI Exchange gold sponsor.
- **Research:** STAR Labs research arm; "Agentic Kill Switch" narrative.
- **Offerings:** Free AI risk assessment offer (self-serve lead gen).

## Industries & solutions
Banks/financial services, hospitals/healthcare, tech/AI companies, media, retail; dedicated solutions for coding agents, productivity agents, and MCP security.

## Relevance to us (AI-Protect / PrivacyScintilla)
- **Category watch:** Straiker owns the "agent inventory/posture" vocabulary. If AI-Protect extends into agent governance for KRITIS customers, Agent-SPM framing will be quoted by buyers.
- **Complementary, not zero-sum (today):** they do not do client-side prompt anonymization or endpoint redaction. A DACH partnership is conceivable but they sell top-down enterprise; no channel program evidence beyond a partners page.
- **Threat vector:** their Defend AI + MCP security could absorb budget that would otherwise fund our future agent-runtime roadmap items.
